notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content: In some cases a house became visible later than intended, though this did not change the solution. This is now fixed.

notes.title: Improvements for certain graphic drivers
notes.content:
This update should help to overcome a glitch on some buggy graphics drivers.

If you encounter any bugs, don't hesitate to contact us at info@polygonmatter.com.

notes.title: Small improvements and Linux support
notes.content: The game was already playable on Linux through Proton, but this patch adds native Linux support as another option.
